authorization: lead directive 2026-08-27 03:4x: '开始,扩展到所有数据' following the v17 budget-falsification report; earlier standing directives: long training carries final accuracy, no memory engineering.
hypothesis: the wide128 recipe is DATA-limited, not budget-limited (v17): expanding fit from 192 to all 2165 routed-family train records lifts confirm joint gain beyond the v16/v17 plateau (+0.0203). r4e13 monotonicity (24:-0.033 / 96:+0.014 / 192:+0.023) is the backing evidence.

panel_v2.rule: fit2 = all train records of the three routed families minus every v1 confirm/smoke reservation (pilot_confirm, long_calibration, final_train_confirm, smoke); anomaly family excluded (no route/basis in this line); deterministic lexicographic, no sampling
panel_v2.abstain_policy: a fit2 record whose deployment routing abstains or exceeds CONDITION_MAXIMUM is SKIPPED and listed in the terminal (v16 build refused instead; skipping is required because fit2 was never routing-screened). A confirm abstain is still a refusal.

storage.scheme: per-rank in-process build, fp16 CPU-resident bundles in anonymous RAM, no shard files (145GB total does not fit /dev/shm or disk; cgroup 240GiB holds it)
storage.shards: WORLD_SHARDS=4, rank r builds and holds partition r (sorted ids, index%4), ~541 fit + ~6 confirm each, ~36GB/rank
storage.precision_disclosure: bundles stored fp16, all compute after load casts to fp32. Confirm metrics carry ~1e-4 relative loading noise versus the fp32 v16/v17 chain; thresholds are unchanged and this noise is immaterial at the 0.005-0.01 gate scale.
storage.build_cost_estimate: ~2165 x 15.8 GPU-s / 4 = ~2.4h one-time; NCCL timeout raised to 6h to cover it

B_data_hinge.role: secondary; r4e14 C-arm configuration, provenance = post-hoc observation (joint >= control on all 6 snapshots, uniform flipped positive), preregistered here for confirmation. Same bundles, cold start, same seed.

plan.sampling: shuffled_epochs over the rank's own partition, generator seed SEED+rank (v16 long_ddp4 scheme verbatim)
plan.optimizer: AdamW lr 3e-3 constant, betas (0.9,0.99), wd 1e-4, clip 1.0, seed 372, cold start per arm
plan.monitor: mean confirm calibration loss; best.pt per arm by monitor

readouts.data_hypothesis: on A_data final: joint >= 0.03 strong confirmation; 0.0203 < joint < 0.03 partial (data helps, sublinear); joint <= 0.0203 data-scaling FALSIFIED at this scale
readouts.hinge_readout: B versus A on harm count, nonworse count, worst_harm, joint; B is confirmatory for the r4e14 post-hoc observation

threshold_provenance: gates inherited verbatim from the frozen v17 preregistration (tolerance redefinition disclosed there); readout boundaries 0.0203/0.03 fixed from the v16/v17 measured plateau and its +-0.003 oscillation band, frozen before any v18 scoring
failure_signal: any gate fails on A_data -> fail_gate accounting; A joint <= 0.0203 -> data hypothesis falsified
kill_switch: non-finite loss/grad refusal; vram gate 8GiB; per-rank build RSS logged, SIGKILL risk acknowledged at 240GiB cgroup; total wall 21600s
rollback: artifacts only under results/r16_dscp_v18/; parent 448035bd sha-checked before/after; frozen v16/v17 chains and their preregs untouched; /dev/shm v16 shards untouched
truth_scope: train split only, allowlisted to fit2+confirm; validation/test_id sealed
